uploader.title: Drop a QR code image here
uploader.tip: or paste an image, an otpauth:// URL or a Base32 secret with

clipboard.failed: The browser blocked the copy. Select the text and copy it manually.

errors.noQrFound: No QR code found in the image. Upload a sharper image or crop it to the QR code.
errors.unsupportedFormat: This is not an authenticator QR code. It must contain an otpauth://totp/ or otpauth-migration:// URL.
errors.noSecret: The otpauth:// URL has no secret parameter. Copy the whole URL and paste it again.
errors.invalidSecret: The secret is not valid Base32. A secret contains only the letters A–Z and the digits 2–7: check it for 0, 1, 8 or 9.
errors.noData: The otpauth-migration:// URL has no data parameter. Copy the whole URL and paste it again.
errors.failedToLoad: The file cannot be opened as an image. Upload a PNG, JPG, GIF, BMP or WebP file.
errors.canvasNotAvailable: The browser did not provide a canvas, so the image cannot be read. Reload the page or open it in another browser.
errors.unknown: The contents could not be parsed ({{detail}}). Check that the image or URL is complete.
